# Polished Insurance

> Specialist insurance broker for UK cleaning businesses. Polished Insurance is a trading name of Allied Insurance Services Ltd, authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FRN 309497). Phone 01942 403370.

## Insurance for cleaning businesses
- [Contract Cleaners Insurance](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/contract-cleaners-insurance): For companies cleaning offices, schools, retail and industrial sites under contract.
- [Commercial & Office Cleaning Insurance](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/commercial-cleaning-insurance): For office, shop, gym and commercial premises cleaners.
- [Domestic Cleaners Insurance](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/domestic-cleaners-insurance): For self-employed home cleaners and domestic cleaning agencies.
- [Window Cleaners Insurance](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/window-cleaners-insurance): For residential and commercial window cleaners, including water-fed pole systems.
- [Carpet & Upholstery Cleaners Insurance](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/carpet-cleaners-insurance): For carpet, rug and upholstery cleaning specialists.
- [End of Tenancy Cleaning Insurance](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/end-of-tenancy-cleaning-insurance): For end of tenancy, move-in and deep cleaning businesses.
- [Oven Cleaners Insurance](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/oven-cleaners-insurance): For oven, range and extractor cleaning specialists and franchisees.
- [Pressure Washing & Driveway Cleaning Insurance](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/pressure-washing-insurance): For driveway, patio, render, roof and exterior cleaning.
- [Specialist & Deep Cleaning Insurance](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/specialist-cleaning-insurance): For builders cleans, kitchen extraction, biohazard and industrial cleaning.
- [Public Liability Insurance for Cleaners](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/public-liability-insurance-for-cleaners): Injury to the public and damage to third-party property.
- [Employers' Liability Insurance for Cleaning Companies](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/employers-liability-insurance-for-cleaners): The legal requirement once you employ cleaners.
- [Tools & Equipment Insurance for Cleaners](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/tools-and-equipment-insurance-for-cleaners): Machines, vacuums, pressure washers and pole systems.
- [Loss of Keys Insurance for Cleaners](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/loss-of-keys-insurance): Replacement keys, fobs and locks for client premises.
- [Professional Indemnity for Cleaning & Facilities Companies](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/cleaning-insurance/professional-indemnity-insurance-for-cleaning-companies): For advice, specifications, audits and consultancy.

## Guides
- [Do I Really Need Insurance for My Cleaning Business?](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/guides/do-i-need-insurance-for-cleaning): Many new cleaners ask whether insurance is a legal requirement. Here is what the law says, and why going without is a big risk.
- [Legal Liability for Cleaners Entering Client Premises](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/guides/legal-liability-cleaner-entering-premises): Your duty of care, keyholding risks and legal responsibilities when working in a client's home or office.
- [Public Liability vs Employers' Liability: What's the Difference?](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/guides/public-liability-vs-employers-liability): We break down the key differences between public and employers' liability, and which your cleaning business actually needs.
- [COSHH Explained Simply: A Cleaner's Guide to Safety](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/guides/coshh-explained-simply): Chemical safety does not have to be complicated. Our simple guide to COSHH helps you stay safe and compliant.
- [The True Cost of a Claim: It's More Than Just the Breakage](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/guides/the-true-cost-of-a-cleaning-claim): Think a broken vase just costs the price of a replacement? We explore the hidden costs of liability claims.
- [Keyholding Risks Explained: Protecting Your Client's Security](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/guides/keyholding-risks-explained): Holding keys for clients is a big responsibility. Learn how to manage keys securely and check your insurance covers you if you lose them.
- [Handling Accidental Damage: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/guides/handling-accidental-damage-cleaning): Breaking a client's item is every cleaner's nightmare. Here is the professional way to handle it.
- [Treatment Risks: The Gap in Standard Public Liability](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/guides/what-is-treatment-risk-insurance): Most standard public liability policies will not pay for the item you are actually cleaning. We explain damage to property worked upon.
- [Employers' Liability Insurance for Cleaning Companies Explained](https://www.polished-insurance.co.uk/guides/employers-liability-insurance-cleaning-company): If your cleaning business has staff, casual helpers or labour-only subcontractors, employers' liability cover is almost certainly a legal requirement. Here is who counts, what the law says, and what insurers will ask you.
